description: This Java class `DigitalProductDaoImpl` implements data access object (DAO) for `DigitalProduct` entities, providing methods to fetch digital products by associated product and merchant store, and by digital product ID, using JPA queries.

classes.name: DigitalProductDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of DAO for accessing DigitalProduct entities, extending base DAO implementation and providing custom query methods.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a DigitalProduct associated with a specific MerchantStore and Product. Throws NonUniqueResultException if more than one result is found.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a DigitalProduct entity by its unique ID.
